title: Mez product architecture and gradient assignment 01
purpose: Resolve the five-product public family, durable product IDs, historical product-name disposition and source-backed Living Core assignments before canonical cutover.

recommendation.legacyPolicy: Retire Aurora and Forge as public names but retain them as migration aliases. Retire Prism without mapping it to Organic Content OS because the product function changed.
recommendation.assignmentPolicy: Preserve approved continuity where it is strong, keep AI OS locked and give Context Engine a visually distinct mineral core.
